relation_to_previous: New target and separately preregistered trial; 纸屿茶舍 prior implicit-imagegen trial stays invalid 0/2; no backfill or reroll.
business_brief: fictional small independent bookshop, quiet modern Chinese identity
carrier: Two separate normal ChatGPT chat pages, same authenticated browser; manually visible exact full prompt per arm and verified posted message; ChatGPT image tool auto-select, not hidden image_gen inferred route
carrier_preflight: Read-only normal composer fill/readback/clear had passed in prior experiment, now recheck and ensure message echo

A.prompt: 请直接创建一张图片：为虚构独立书店「竹影书屋」制作 A 版中性中文文字标志。画面比例 3:2 横向，透明背景，只有从左到右单行排列的四个准确简体汉字「竹影书屋」，纯黑色，居中完整呈现。使用规范、清晰、笔画完整、横竖撇捺合理的宋体印刷文字，字重、字高、字间距协调；不要做创意变形。特别保留「竹」两部分、「影」右侧三撇、「书」的末笔点、「屋」上方尸部与下方至部。禁止任何额外汉字、拼音、说明、标题、编号、商标图形、边框、图片对照、尺寸标签、报告、表格、底纹、人物、装饰或水印。图片中不能出现 A 字母或“中性版”等字样。只输出一张独立文字标志图片，不要输出设计讲解图。

B.prompt: 请直接创建一张图片：为虚构独立书店「竹影书屋」制作 B 版原创设计语法中文文字标志。画面比例 3:2 横向，透明背景，只有从左到右单行排列的四个准确简体汉字「竹影书屋」，纯黑色，居中完整呈现。整体是克制、有书卷气且具有鲜明品牌识别度的现代中文艺术字标，不要简单套用标准印刷字体，也不要用毛笔飞白或花纹充当设计。先完整保留四字语义与必要结构：「竹」两部分、「影」右侧三撇、「书」末笔点、「屋」上方尸部与下方至部；再调整整组轮廓、内白、字重和节奏。只允许在一至两处原生笔画收笔中做有原因的细微呼应，不能靠每个字机械加横线、长尾或新笔画。相邻汉字之间保留明显边界，64像素高度下仍然可读。禁止任何额外汉字、拼音、说明、标题、编号、商标图形、边框、图片对照、尺寸标签、报告、表格、底纹、人物、装饰或水印。图片中不能出现 B 字母或“设计版”等字样。只输出一张独立文字标志图片，不要输出设计讲解图。

gates.submission: Exact full prompt must be visible in posted user message; if composer or reply proof missing, stop and mark as not executed rather than claiming success.
gates.format: Must return exactly one complete image of standalone brand wordmark. A design report, infographic, wrong characters, or two artboards are immediate invalid and kept as negative evidence.
gates.glyph: Must visually contain 竹影书屋 with 影 right 彡, 书 final dot, 屋 尸+至; do not equate an image description/OCR with independent human readback.
gates.pixel: If source PNG is accessible, record actual bytes and SHA256, dimensions and alpha. Only after valid result create 256/96/64/32 equal-ink-height comparisons. Full-column gaps are manual review triggers, not automatic errors.
gates.aesthetic: Only if both arms content/format valid, ask truly independent Chinese reader for recognition and brand suitability; AI judging the work itself is a nonblind diagnostic only.

confounds: Two different text lengths and policies; better design version may benefit from richer instructions rather than distilled method
Backends may be non-deterministic, model version and seed undisclosed
Two separate chats aren't necessarily independent model instances, nor is human-blind review available
Even 2/2 visual success would only establish carrier and output validity, not professional design-method efficacy
stop_conditions: No proper result image or wrong text after first assistant reply
Not eligible to submit more than one message or generate retries
No Figma writes, no R30 and no modifications of formal status
expected_artifacts: Raw message echo and two exact posted prompt strings
One-shot generation attempt evidence for each arm
Actual image ids and hashes if accessible
Explicit negative verdict if not valid
